title: The music next door
setting: A Saturday morning in the corridor of their apartment building. Yuki is heading out when Satou-san, the elderly neighbour on the other side of her thin wall, stops her. She's sure he's about to complain about her music.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: a, yuki-san, ohayou gozaimasu. chotto ii desu ka?
lines.ja: あ、ユキさん、おはようございます。ちょっといいですか？
lines.kana: あ、ゆきさん、おはようございます。ちょっといいですか？
lines.english: Ah, Yuki-san, good morning. Have you got a moment?

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.ja: おはようございます。はい、どうしました？
lines.kana: おはようございます。はい、どうしました？
lines.english: Good morning. Sure, what is it?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: yoru, yoku ongaku o kakete imasu yo ne.
lines.ja: 夜、よく音楽をかけていますよね。
lines.kana: よる、よくおんがくをかけていますよね。
lines.english: You often have music on in the evenings, don't you?

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.ja: あ、すみません！うるさかったですか？
lines.kana: あ、すみません！うるさかったですか？
lines.english: Oh, I'm sorry! Was it too loud?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: iie, sou ja nai n desu. kinou no yoru wa ongaku o kakete inakatta node, dou shita no kana to omotte.
lines.ja: いいえ、そうじゃないんです。昨日の夜は音楽をかけていなかったので、どうしたのかなと思って。
lines.kana: いいえ、そうじゃないんです。きのうのよるはおんがくをかけていなかったので、どうしたのかなとおもって。
lines.english: No, it's not that. Last night you didn't have any music on, so I wondered if something was wrong.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: a, kinou wa kaeri ga osokatta n desu. demo satou-san, watashi no ongaku, kiiteru n desu ka?
lines.ja: あ、昨日は帰りが遅かったんです。でも佐藤さん、私の音楽、聞いてるんですか？
lines.kana: あ、きのうはかえりがおそかったんです。でもさとうさん、わたしのおんがく、きいてるんですか？
lines.english: Oh, I got home late last night. But Satou-san, you listen to my music?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: hai. saikin wa, terebi o minai n desu yo.
lines.ja: はい。最近は、テレビを見ないんですよ。
lines.kana: はい。さいきんは、テレビをみないんですよ。
lines.english: I do. I don't watch TV these days, you see.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: doushite desu ka? asa mo yoru mo, nyuusu o mite imashita yo ne.
lines.ja: どうしてですか？朝も夜も、ニュースを見ていましたよね。
lines.kana: どうしてですか？あさもよるも、ニュースをみていましたよね。
lines.english: How come? You used to have the news on morning and night.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: sore ga, nyuusu o miru to, warui hanashi bakari de.
lines.ja: それが、ニュースを見ると、悪い話ばかりで。
lines.kana: それが、ニュースをみると、わるいはなしばかりで。
lines.english: The thing is, whenever I watch the news, it's nothing but bad stories.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: aa, sou desu ne. jaa, channeru o kaetara dou desu ka?
lines.ja: ああ、そうですね。じゃあ、チャンネルを変えたらどうですか？
lines.kana: ああ、そうですね。じゃあ、チャンネルをかえたらどうですか？
lines.english: Ah, that's true. Well, how about changing the channel?

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: channeru o kaete mo, doko mo nyuusu bakari desu yo. dakara, yuki-san no ongaku o kiku no ga tanoshimi na n desu.
lines.ja: チャンネルを変えても、どこもニュースばかりですよ。だから、ユキさんの音楽を聞くのが楽しみなんです。
lines.kana: チャンネルをかえても、どこもニュースばかりですよ。だから、ゆきさんのおんがくをきくのがたのしみなんです。
lines.english: Even if I change the channel, it's news everywhere. So listening to your music is what I look forward to.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: sou datta n desu ka. watashi mo terebi wa minai node, itsumo ongaku o kaketeru n desu.
lines.ja: そうだったんですか。私もテレビは見ないので、いつも音楽をかけてるんです。
lines.kana: そうだったんですか。わたしもテレビはみないので、いつもおんがくをかけてるんです。
lines.english: Oh, so that's why. I don't watch TV either, so I always have music on.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: kinou wa, terebi mo minai shi, ongaku mo nai shi, chotto sabishikatta desu yo.
lines.ja: 昨日は、テレビも見ないし、音楽もないし、ちょっと寂しかったですよ。
lines.kana: きのうは、テレビもみないし、おんがくもないし、ちょっとさびしかったですよ。
lines.english: So last night, with no TV and no music, it was a bit lonely.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: sumimasen! jaa, kyou wa uchi ni kaettara, sugu ongaku o kakemasu ne.
lines.ja: すみません！じゃあ、今日はうちに帰ったら、すぐ音楽をかけますね。
lines.kana: すみません！じゃあ、きょうはうちにかえったら、すぐおんがくをかけますね。
lines.english: I'm sorry! Then today I'll put music on the minute I get home.

lines.speaker: satou
lines.romaji: arigatou gozaimasu. tanoshimi ni shite imasu.
lines.ja: ありがとうございます。楽しみにしています。
lines.kana: ありがとうございます。たのしみにしています。
lines.english: Thank you. I'll look forward to it.

choices.english: Satou-san tells Yuki her music was too loud last night, and she promises to turn it down from now on.
Satou-san's TV only shows the news, so Yuki offers to come round tonight and change the channel for him.
Satou-san has stopped watching TV because the news is all bad. He enjoys Yuki's music and missed it last night, and she promises to put it on as soon as she gets home.

questions.explanation: Lines 3-5: Satou-san brings up Yuki's music, but not to complain (iie, sou ja nai n desu). Last night she had none on, and he wondered if something was wrong. Lines 7-11: he doesn't watch TV these days, because the news is all bad stories and every channel is news, so listening to her music is what he looks forward to. Line 13: last night was a bit lonely. Line 14: she'll put music on as soon as she gets home today. A is wrong: Yuki asks if it was too loud (line 4), but he says that's not it, and there was no music at all last night (line 5). B is wrong: changing the channel is Yuki's suggestion (line 10), he says every channel is news anyway (line 11), and what she offers is music, not a visit.

questions.english: Mai asks you, "uchi ni kaettara, itsumo nani shiteru no?" (What do you usually do once you get home?) Tell her you watch TV.
questions.ja: うちに帰ったら、いつも何してるの？
questions.kana: うちにかえったら、いつもなにしてるの？
questions.romaji: uchi ni kaettara, itsumo nani shiteru no?
questions.answer: Say you watch TV, with terebi and miru in the -teru form for something you do as a routine: terebi miteru kana.

modelAnswers.ja: いつもテレビを見ています。

questions.explanation: TV takes miru, the same 'watch' verb as the news. The -teru form (miteru, polite mite imasu) is what you do as a routine, like Yuki's itsumo ongaku o kaketeru in line 12. Satou-san uses the negative in line 7 (saikin wa, terebi o minai n desu), and so does Yuki in line 12 (terebi wa minai node). Casual speech drops o, and kana softens it to 'I guess'. The polite model is for someone like Tanaka-san.

questions.english: After saying every channel is news, Satou-san tells Yuki what he looks forward to instead. What did he say?
questions.ja: 佐藤さんは何が楽しみだと言いましたか？
questions.kana: さとうさんはなにがたのしみだといいましたか？
questions.romaji: satou-san wa nani ga tanoshimi da to iimashita ka?

choices.english: Listening to your music is what I look forward to.
choices.romaji: yuki-san no ongaku o kiku no ga tanoshimi na n desu.

choices.english: Asking your music is what I look forward to.
choices.romaji: yuki-san no ongaku ni kiku no ga tanoshimi na n desu.

choices.english: Putting your music on is what I look forward to.
choices.romaji: yuki-san no ongaku o kakeru no ga tanoshimi na n desu.

questions.explanation: Line 11: ongaku o kiku is listening to music, and Satou-san is the one listening, from next door. B turns English 'listen to' into ni. With ni, kiku means asking someone (sensei ni kiku), so it would mean asking her music something. Listening takes o, or a dropped o, as in Yuki's line 6 (watashi no ongaku, kiiteru n desu ka?). C uses kakeru, putting music on, which is Yuki's part (lines 3, 12 and 14): she puts it on, and he listens.

questions.english: Kenta asks you, "ne, kesa no nyuusu mita? yabakatta yo." (Did you see the news this morning? It was crazy.) You haven't. Tell him you haven't seen the news this morning, and ask what happened.
questions.ja: ね、今朝のニュース見た？やばかったよ。
questions.kana: ね、けさのニュースみた？やばかったよ。
questions.romaji: ne, kesa no nyuusu mita? yabakatta yo.
questions.answer: Say no, with nyuusu and miru in the -te nai form ('haven't seen'): uun, kesa wa nyuusu mitenai. nani ga atta no?

modelAnswers.romaji: uun, kesa wa nyuusu mitenai. nani ga atta no?
modelAnswers.ja: ううん、今朝はニュース見てない。何があったの？
modelAnswers.english: No, I haven't seen the news this morning. What happened?

modelAnswers.romaji: iie, kesa wa nyuusu o mite imasen. nani ka atta n desu ka?
modelAnswers.ja: いいえ、今朝はニュースを見ていません。何かあったんですか？
modelAnswers.english: No, I haven't seen the news this morning. Did something happen?

questions.explanation: The news takes miru, just like TV, and that covers a news app on your phone too. Yuki and Satou-san use it in lines 8-9 (nyuusu o mite imashita yo ne / nyuusu o miru to). Mitenai (polite mite imasen) is 'haven't seen it', the natural reply when something is news to you, and kesa wa means 'this morning, at least'. Kiku is only for the news on the radio. The polite model is for someone like Tanaka-san.

questions.english: You're at Kenta's flat and he's cooking. He says, "gohan, mou sugu dekiru kara ne." (The food'll be ready soon.) Ask if it's okay to put some music on.
questions.ja: ご飯、もうすぐできるからね。
questions.kana: ごはん、もうすぐできるからね。
questions.romaji: gohan, mou sugu dekiru kara ne.
questions.answer: Ask permission with ongaku and kakeru in the -te form plus ii?: jaa, ongaku kakete ii?

modelAnswers.ja: じゃあ、音楽かけていい？
modelAnswers.english: Okay. Mind if I put some music on?

modelAnswers.romaji: ongaku kakete mo ii? nani ga ii?
modelAnswers.ja: 音楽かけてもいい？何がいい？
modelAnswers.english: Mind if I put some music on? What do you feel like?

questions.explanation: Starting music on a speaker is ongaku o kakeru, Yuki's habit in lines 3, 12 and 14 (sugu ongaku o kakemasu ne). English 'play' is not asobu here (that's play for fun) and not hiku (playing an instrument). It isn't ongaku o kiku either: that's the listening, which is Satou-san's part (lines 6 and 11). Kakete ii? and kakete mo ii? both ask 'is it okay if I...?', and casual speech drops o.

questions.english: When Satou-san says the news is nothing but bad stories, Yuki asks, "jaa, channeru o kaetara dou desu ka?" What is she suggesting?
questions.ja: ユキさんは何をしたらいいと言いましたか？
questions.kana: ゆきさんはなにをしたらいいといいましたか？
questions.romaji: yuki-san wa nani o shitara ii to iimashita ka?

choices.english: That he stop watching TV for a while.
That he switch to a different channel.
That he head back home for now.

questions.explanation: Line 10: channeru o kaeru is changing the channel, and kaetara dou desu ka? is 'how about changing it?'. Satou-san's reply in line 11 confirms it: channeru o kaete mo, doko mo nyuusu bakari (even if I change the channel, it's news everywhere). A is what he already does (line 7: saikin wa, terebi o minai n desu). That would be terebi o minai, with no channel in it. C mixes up kaeru 'change' with kaeru 'go home'. Going home is kaettara, with a double t, as in Yuki's line 14 (uchi ni kaettara); changing is kaetara, with one.

newWords.english: noisy, too loud (urusakatta desu ka? = was it too loud?)
something to look forward to (tanoshimi ni shite imasu = I'm looking forward to it)
